captureRecipe: Every feature observation records actual stat, abort, read calls/bytes, awaited close, descriptor probe, original service outcome, write entry and actual mutation attempts before assertions.
All tool-root/home/cwd/config entries have complete byte/identity/permission/mtime manifests; atime and deliberately modified control/gate/report files are excluded.
SDK release requires a file written by the actual server callback AbortSignal listener; client rejection and ping alone are insufficient.
SDK child close, termination attempts, errors, stderr byte count, subsequent service health/read and audit are captured before assertions. Unconfirmed child cleanup retains the owned fixture.
All first output including failures and setup/cleanup faults is retained losslessly; these faults are not feature RED.
limitations: No OS read interruption guarantee, deployment, client-login or broad parity acceptance.
